candidates.description: This feature vector represents common French morphological suffixes and verb endings, particularly associated with conjugated forms and nouns containing the "ier" or "ère" roots.
These tokens represent Spanish prepositions and prepositional phrases used to indicate spatial, temporal, or logical relationships.
This feature detects French words and syllables starting with the accented letter 'é' or 'É'.
This vector is related to Spanish adjectives and determiners expressing identity, equivalence, or manner.
This vector represents common Spanish and Portuguese verb roots, prefixes, and grammatical morphemes associated with action and consequence.
This vector activates for tokens containing the Spanish root/prefix "seg-" or phonetically similar word fragments related to sequence and following.
This vector is related to letter sequences and words containing the Spanish or French root "qu".
This vector represents terms of quantity, negation, and limitation, such as "all," "no," "just," and their cross-lingual equivalents.
These tokens represent various verb stems and lexical roots, often involving abstract states, relationships, or existential concepts across multiple languages.
This vector represents societal, legal, and institutional domains.
